description: Rathnayake Mudiyanselage Punchibanda v. Hon. Attorney General Rathnayake Mudiyanselage Punchibanda v. Hon. Attorney General View More before Hon. K.K. Wickramasinghe, J
parties: Rathnayake Mudiyanselage Punchibanda v. Hon. Attorney General Rathnayake Mudiyanselage Punchibanda v. Hon. Attorney General View More
keywords: Criminal appeal – Murder and grievous hurt – Long-standing land dispute – Grave and sudden provocation – Sudden fight – Medical evidence – Intoxication – Intention – Murder conviction reduced to culpable homicide not amounting to murder – Death sentence quashed – Twenty years rigorous imprisonment imposed on first charge – Conviction and sentence on grievous-hurt charge affirmed – Sentences consecutive – Appeal dismissed subject to variation. M.M.A. Gaffoor J. agreed.
legistation: Penal Code – sections 296, 297 and 317; Code of Criminal Procedure Act No. 15 of 1979 – section 331; Evidence Ordinance principles concerning exceptions/onus are discussed.
